request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material, skin and fabric texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Image 1 shows Ana and Luis. Keep both faces, hair and clothes exactly: Luis is about thirty with short curly black hair and a navy T-shirt; Ana is about thirty with long wavy black hair and an olive-green shirt over a white top. Create a NEW photograph in a bright room: Luis stands on the left and holds a plain white envelope in one hand and a pen in the other, the pen tip resting on the blank front of the envelope, ready to write. He ASKS Ana a question: he looks at her with raised eyebrows and an open mouth, mid-question, as someone who needs her address to send a letter. Ana stands on the right and listens with a smile. Both are seen from the waist up, sharp. The envelope is completely blank. Exactly two people; no phones, and no readable letters, words or numbers anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
